subject: SIG: GDPR/DPA/SCCs + BAA feasibility for Wellbridge Diagnostics
messages:
From: Lena Hoffman <lena@wellbridgedx.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Riles <tom.riles@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — privacy/residency & potential BAA

Hi Aditya,

We're moving through our vendor security review for the pilot and need to get a completed SIG questionnaire and a few clarifications around privacy/regulatory fit. Quick context: Wellbridge stores de-identified test results today but may ingest limited PHI during onboarding. We need to understand:

- Do you have a standard BAA/BAA-equivalent for customers that process PHI?
- How do you handle cross-border transfers (do you rely on SCCs / DPA)?
- Any constraints on deploying in a dedicated VPC or private instance in our AWS account?

Can you share the SIG XLSX and the set of evidence (SOC 2 summary, encryption docs, KMS details) your team normally provides? We aim to get legal/compliance comfortable by EOW next week.

I'm attaching our vendor intake checklist (attachment: Wellbridge_vendor-checklist.pdf). If it helps, Tom (cc'd) is our technical lead and can join a short call.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffman
Head of Security
Wellbridge Diagnostics

[attachment: Wellbridge_vendor-checklist.pdf]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Hoffman <lena@wellbridgedx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — privacy/residency & potential BAA

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear note and for looping Tom in.

Quick summary / plan from our side:
1) I'll attach a current SIG workbook (Wellbridge_SIG_2027.xlsx) and a short SOC2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) in this thread.
2) Monica (Security & Compliance) will own the detailed evidence handoff for SIG items (network, encryption, access control).
3) Neha (Privacy) will advise on DPA/SCCs and BAA feasibility given the potential PHI signal during onboarding.

Short answers up front:
- BAA: We do offer a BAA for customers handling PHI but there are different delivery models (hosted + BAA, Dedicated with BAA, or Private deployment with customer-managed keys). We'll confirm which model fits Wellbridge after a short intake call.
- Cross-border transfers: We support SCCs and a DPA for EU data by default for hosted customers; private deployments can remove cross-border transfer concerns.
- Dedicated/private: We have a Private option (VPC + optional on-prem package) and can discuss bringing up a dedicated VPC in your AWS account with our on-call infra team.

Proposed next steps:
- Please confirm a 30-min slot this week with Tom to walk through the SIG scope and which services will see PHI during onboarding.
- Monica will send a follow-up listing the top 20 evidence artifacts we usually provide and the expected format.
- If you anticipate needing a signed BAA before pilot data moves, let us know and we'll route a draft through legal.

Attachments: Wellbridge_SIG_2027.xlsx (SIG workbook), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 highlights).

I'll set up a calendar invite once you confirm availability.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 04 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG request — privacy/residency & potential BAA

Forwarding Aditya's reply to start an internal evidence plan.

Key points from an evidence and legal-readiness perspective (action items):

- PHI risk: If Wellbridge will knowingly process PHI during onboarding, a BAA will be required. Ask product/ops which pipelines may touch PHI (S3 buckets, ingestion ETL, logs).
- Evidence tranche: I'll prepare a prioritized evidence bundle ("Tier 1" items we can deliver within 3 business days) including: SOC2 report excerpt, encryption at rest/in transit summary, KMS usage doc, MFA/SSO screenshots, RBAC matrix, vulnerability scan summary.
- SIG answers: We'll pre-fill the SIG where we can and flag items needing architecture diagrams or tenant-specific deployment details.
- Deployment model: Recommend we propose a Dedicated pool or Private deployment if customer must avoid cross-border transfer; propose the hosted+DPA route only if Wellbridge is comfortable with SCCs.

Attachments to prep: draft-baa-template.docx (legal will need to review before sending), evidence checklist spreadsheet (I'll put this into the Drive link).

Neha — can you confirm the DPA/SCC stance and flag any jurisdictional checks? I expect a short legal review but want to avoid surprises.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
